_note: Gold values for the six brief figures. Reconciled against recovered public sources (see recovered_values.md). 'verified':true means the value is confirmed by a public source OR read directly from a label/residual guide on the figure itself. 'verified':false means an eyeballed read with no public confirmation (figures 3 and 4 name real programs but the specific numbers appear synthetic; some waterfall bar reads are not separately published). For figure 5 (a full table shown as a raster), gold is WHAT THE TABLE SHOWS, since the task is reading the figure; where that conflicts with later disclosure it is noted. quantity_key must match evaluation/keys.py.
